summary: Replace partial/previous Markdown streaming with editor.api.markdown.stream()

entries.summary: Use stateful `editor.api.markdown.stream()` with single-pass bounded tail healing, incremental GFM table and code-fence updates, and revision-checked anchored live updates.
migrationNotes: Upgrade `platejs` to the release that adds `editor.api.markdown.stream()` and removes `partial` and `previous` from `parse`, `parseSlice`, and `parseInline`.

Replace `editor.api.markdown.parseSlice(source, { lossPolicy: 'allow', partial: true, previous })` loops with a stateful `const stream = editor.api.markdown.stream()`, calling `stream.append(chunk)` (or `stream.set(source)`) for previews and `stream.finish()` when the stream ends or stops.
Update `markdown-streaming-demo` if you copied it into your app to use `editor.api.markdown.stream()` with revision-checked anchored updates.
